title: Programmes: a solution map run leaf by leaf, composed, and the holdout read once
request: Phase 2 of the owner's plan: a problem of several parts is solved leaf by leaf, the leaves are composed, and the composed system is scored once on the holdout against the best single leaf.
spec: dclab_core compose (candidates, choice on validation, one read with a cluster bootstrap and a paired difference), leaves (the shared split, a screen, a classifier that reads the screen, links), programme (Programme v1, plan, replan, drop, validate, report); dclab_rnd studio programme, the graph moves run_programme and drop_leaf, a job, three routes, the pipeline steps and replay, the code export; the main-product adapter programme_experiments.
plan: Each leaf fits on the earlier rows, chooses on the validation rows and hands its scores for validation and holdout to the composition; none scores the holdout.
The composition is chosen on validation among every leaf alone and the ways to combine them, a tie to the simpler; the bar is the best leaf on validation, never on the holdout.
The holdout opens only when every leaf that was to run has run and the composition is chosen on enough confirmed cases; it is read once, and every later read is a person's written decision.
A leaf that cannot run is a blocker with its reason until a person drops it, and a drop is refused once the holdout was read.
The record holds names, counts and scores, never a row; the code export reproduces the number from dclab_core alone.

decisions.decision: The leaves are the core's own runners on one shared split, not one engine project each.
decisions.why: The engine's five stages run their own splits and would read the holdout once per project; one split and one read for the whole is the point of the package. A project per leaf stays open.

decisions.decision: The best leaf the composition must beat is chosen on validation, and taken among every built leaf.
decisions.why: A bar chosen on the holdout would move to whichever leaf happens to win there, and a stronger leaf outside the fusion would otherwise never be the bar.

decisions.decision: Rank maximum is a candidate, not a rule: the composition is whatever wins on validation, the best leaf alone included.
decisions.why: Rare frauds are visible to one leaf each, so the top of any leaf is what counts; a combination that does not help is not chosen and the result says so.

decisions.decision: The holdout count is carried by the split design, not by the solution map.
decisions.why: New routes or a new table change the map but not the rows of the holdout; seeing them again under new routes is a second look.

decisions.decision: The replica's scale was calibrated for statistical power on other seeds (10 to 15) before the acceptance seeds (0 to 2) were run.
decisions.why: With few fraudulent bikers a bootstrap over bikers is too wide to tell a gain from chance; scale is chosen for power, never for a result.

change: dclab_core compose.py, leaves.py, programme.py, replicas/fraud_programme.py, schemas programme.json and baseline, adapter programme_experiments, conformance, CHANGELOG 0.54.0; dclab_rnd studio/programme.py, graph.py (run_programme, drop_leaf, node states, plan sign-off), pipeline.py (programme steps and replay), code.py (export_programme), draft/map.py (project_plan), draft/api.py, jobs/handlers.py, routers/projects.py, api_models.py (slim plan), services.py, data.py (labels keep the budget); the problem map's budget phrase keeps its percent sign; tests test_compose, test_leaves, test_programme, test_studio_programme and additions.

findings.defect: The holdout could be read twice with no reason, by an agent too, after a leaf was dropped once the first number was known.
findings.scenario: Run 1 reads the holdout; the accounts table is replaced by one with no contact column; run 2 is blocked (no read); the person drops the rings leaf (accepted, because the stored document had no holdout); run 3 as an agent with no reason reads the holdout again.
findings.cause: 'Read' was taken only from the current document; the project's count and the earlier programmes were ignored.
findings.fix: The graph rule uses the project's holdout count and the stored document; Programme carries reads_before by split design and drop_leaf refuses after any read; drop is a graph move.

findings.defect: A replay or a pipeline rerun read the holdout on changed inputs with no gate, no reason and no count.
findings.scenario: Run, change the budget from 0.02 to 0.05, replay: a different holdout number, holdout_uses unchanged.
findings.cause: Replay re-executed the programme without checking that the inputs were those of the run.
findings.fix: A replay is refused when anything the run read has changed, or when the stored programme never read the holdout; the pipeline returns the reason.

findings.defect: The recorded inputs could describe other data than the run read, and the stale check missed the budget, the exclusions and the label file's budget.
findings.scenario: A table replaced during a run left stale: []; re-attaching the same label file dropped alert_budget so the next run silently used 1% instead of 2%.
findings.cause: inputs_of ran after the run on a re-fetched project; the project was not marked running; attach_labels replaced the whole suggestion.
findings.fix: The project is marked running (no table can be attached under it) and the inputs are recorded from the snapshot the run used; inputs include the budget, the excluded columns, the core version, the seed; attach_labels keeps the budget.

findings.defect: The split silently became a random or group split while the record still said time.
findings.scenario: A numeric (unix seconds) or unparseable created_at: partition fell through to a group split and the holdout held days earlier than the fit rows; rows with no timestamp belonged to no period without a word.
findings.cause: partition tried the day split and fell through; the info was never compared with the design.
findings.fix: A design that names a moment is never answered by another split: partition refuses with the reason, counts the rows with no period and refuses more than 5%; the links leaf refuses a moment that is not dates.

findings.defect: Columns declared unavailable at the prediction moment still reached every leaf.
findings.scenario: A numeric forbidden column in the rides table became a measure for the screen and the classifier.
findings.cause: excluded() read only the suggestion's identifiers and the label key.
findings.fix: excluded() is the union of the suggestion's and the solution's identifiers and forbidden columns, the label key, and every leak suspect, outcome or identifier of the data card.

findings.defect: The one read could be spent on a meaningless choice: no confirmed case among the validation rows, or among the holdout rows.
findings.scenario: Labels zeroed on validation: every candidate ties at 0, the first leaf is chosen and the holdout is consumed.
findings.cause: Zero positives only produced a warning.
findings.fix: open_issues refuses a composition chosen on fewer than five confirmed cases and read_holdout counts the holdout's cases before reading; the programme stays at leaves_built with the reason.

findings.defect: The exported code could not read its own data in a clean environment.
findings.scenario: A project built from a draft has parquet tables; requirements.txt listed no pyarrow.
findings.cause: export_programme pinned BASE only.
findings.fix: The requirements add pyarrow for parquet and openpyxl for spreadsheets, and a stale programme is refused for export.

findings.defect: The new write routes were not in the experience log's registry; the harness gate and the journey test were not run.
findings.scenario: test_every_write_route_says_what_it_records failed; test_harness_gate asked for make harness-eval; the journey test called refresh_plan, which did not exist.
findings.cause: The routes were added without their line, and the gate command was not run.
findings.fix: The two routes are listed with the events they leave; refresh_plan is written; harness-eval is run.

findings.defect: run_programme skipped the solution sign-off.
findings.scenario: With require_solution_signoff and no signed solution a human run was allowed while run_stage was blocked.
findings.cause: The move had no Solution check.
findings.fix: The sign-off is required, and the owner signs a programme's plan (its solution map's fingerprint) when the project has no saved solution.

findings.defect: validate was incomplete: tampered documents with a new fingerprint passed.
findings.scenario: holdout.rows, metric, budget_rows, fused or gates naming a missing block, a blocked leaf at the read, weights or leaves missing a built leaf.
findings.cause: Only the first few invariants were checked.
findings.fix: validate asserts the invariants of a read (rows, metric, budget, the leaves scored, nothing planned or blocked, enough cases) and the maps' correspondence; plan refuses an unsound or foreign solution map.

findings.defect: A reader could run without the score it reads, and ties were broken by row order.
findings.scenario: Two sub-problems with the same predict_rank, the reader listed first: it ran with reads [] and no note. recall_at(zeros, y, 3) was 0 or 1 by where the positives sat.
findings.cause: The order fell back to list position; the stable argsort ranked tied rows by position.
findings.fix: A topological order and a block when a source has not run; recall at a budget is the expected share over the tied rows.

findings.defect: The links leaf read rides of the same day and counted accounts opened later.
findings.scenario: History ran to the end of the ride's own day; the group of accounts sharing a phone was counted as of the export; one placeholder shared by 41 accounts dropped the whole column.
findings.cause: Daily cumulative counts; a static group size; a column-level cap.
findings.fix: History is counted to the ride's own moment (cumulative count in time order); groups are counted as of the ride when the table says when accounts opened; a value shared by more accounts than the cap links nobody, value by value.

findings.defect: Labels were not cut at the prediction time.
findings.scenario: The replica writes confirmed_at three to thirteen days after the ride; cases near the fit and validation edge were learned from before they were confirmed.
findings.cause: The cases' confirmation date was read by nothing.
findings.fix: A model learns a case only from the day it was confirmed (the period's first moment); the held-back cases are counted in the leaf's limits, and a file with no date says so.

findings.defect: With no resamples the interval had zero width yet a gain was claimed; skipped resamples were not counted; the bar was taken only among the fused leaves.
findings.scenario: bootstraps=0 and a positive point difference gave beats_best_leaf True.
findings.cause: The claim read only the interval's low end.
findings.fix: No gain is claimed from fewer than fifty resamples; the skipped count is in the limits; the bar is the best leaf among every built leaf.

findings.defect: The project payload had two shapes for the same key, and the read count undercounted after eleven reads.
findings.scenario: PUT data returned the whole plan while GET returned its fingerprints; earlier[-10:] was used as the count.
findings.cause: slim() was applied on three routes; the count was derived from a capped list.
findings.fix: The Project response model serialises the plan as its fingerprints on every route; the count is kept in its own field; /programme shows the plan's blocks and split.

findings.defect: Once a stage was done the pipeline and the export switched away from the programme.
findings.scenario: A project with both a programme and a finished stage showed only the stages.
findings.cause: The programme steps were added only when no stage was done.
findings.fix: The programme steps are appended to the stages' steps when both exist.

findings.defect: Several tests would have passed with the code wrong.
findings.scenario: Computing the bar from the holdout-best leaf under the validation-best label survived; compose_leaves reading the holdout scores survived; the privacy tests looked at the first twenty ids; the agent's approval was never asserted spent.
findings.cause: Assertions that are always true, and samples instead of all values.
findings.fix: The bar is asserted against the leaf's own holdout score; the composition is asserted to follow the validation scores only; every id, phone and device is searched for in the record; the approval is asserted spent by a read and kept by a blocked run; holdout values are asserted not to reach earlier scores.

findings.defect: With the first replica the fusion did not reliably beat the best single leaf.
findings.scenario: Rank-max fusion gave 0.42 to 0.54 of the planted fraud against 0.49 to 0.60 for the rings leaf alone.
findings.cause: The marks and rings were so many that the review budget could not hold both, and the bootstrap over fraudulent bikers was too wide.
findings.fix: The replica's fraud rate was lowered and, in a second step, the number of independent fraudulent bikers raised (14 rings, 28 markers, few rides each), calibrated on the seeds 10 to 15 before the acceptance seeds were run.

findings.defect: The problem map's budget phrase lost its percent sign.
findings.scenario: 'the team can review about 2% of the rides each day' gave the budget 'team can review about 2'.
findings.cause: The pattern ended in a word boundary, which a percent sign followed by a space does not have.
findings.fix: The number alternative takes an optional percent and the pattern ends in a negative look-ahead.

findings.defect: Importing compose or leaves first broke on a circular import through the contracts.
findings.scenario: python -c 'import dclab_core.compose' failed: Choice not defined in a partially initialised module.
findings.cause: compose imported the contracts at its top and the contracts import chain ends in programme, which needs compose.
findings.fix: The nested contracts (Estimate, Choice, HoldoutResult) live in programme.py and compose imports them where it builds them.
findings.test: fresh-interpreter imports of compose, leaves, programme, solution_map, contracts, problem_map

findings.defect: A project solved by the engine's stages, never run as a programme, listed the programme's steps as missing steps of its pipeline.
findings.scenario: The owner's morning (RG-01) and the first dev journey (JD-01) build a fraud project whose confirmed map is complex and run its five stages: the harness found programme:blk1 to programme:holdout not run and marked the pipeline wrong (15 of 17).
findings.cause: The programme steps were appended whenever the project held a plan.
findings.fix: The programme steps join the pipeline when a programme has run, or when no stage has (the programme is then the project's route); a project solved by its stages keeps its stage pipeline. The failed first run was removed before the rerun, which passed 17 of 17 (HRN-009).

measurements.name: replica calibration
measurements.gate: Chosen before the acceptance seeds: the fusion beats the best leaf with the interval above zero on every one of the dev seeds 10 to 15 at the final scale.
measurements.result: 6 of 6 dev seeds; the composition recalled about 0.98 to 1.0 of the confirmed cases against 0.49 to 0.80 for the best leaf.
limits: The replica is invented data: this says the decisions are sound, never how a model does on real rides.

measurements.name: programme on the fraud replica, seeds 0 to 2
measurements.gate: The composed holdout number beats the best leaf chosen on validation with the paired interval above zero, the holdout read once, on each of three seeds the calibration never saw.
measurements.result: seed 0: 0.962 against 0.679, difference +0.283 (0.109 to 0.495); seed 1: 0.967 against 0.600, +0.367 (0.205 to 0.557); seed 2: 1.000 against 0.564, +0.436 (0.236 to 0.685); 39 to 60 confirmed cases in each holdout; one read each.
limits: Recall of the confirmed cases, partial and biased towards the visible kind.
The bootstrap clusters by biker only; rings also move through accounts.

outcome: A problem of several parts runs as a programme: the leaves on one shared split, the composition chosen on validation, the holdout opened only when every leaf ran and read once; a second read is a person's written decision, a leaf cannot be dropped after it, a replay or an export is refused when the inputs changed, and the exported code reproduces the number from dclab_core alone.
lessons: The holdout's identity is its split, not its routes: count reads by the split design.
A fallback that quietly changes the split is a leak with a friendly face: refuse and say why.
A bar chosen after the holdout is read is not a bar.
Calibrate a replica's power on seeds the acceptance never sees, and say so.
Regenerate a new contract's baseline after the reviewer's fixes and before the gate.
risks: The leaves are the core's runners, not one engine project each; a leaf with its own engine run is open.
No page for the programme and no agent tool for it yet.
The bootstrap clusters by one entity key; rings also move through accounts.
The classifier trains on the screen's in-sample scores and is judged on out-of-sample ones: a cross-fitted screen would remove the skew.
